_about: Klara Stroebe's Swedish and Norwegian folk-tale collections, tr. Frederick H. Martens (1874-1932). Martens is the translator; the tales are traditional and Stroebe the compiler. Gutenberg cleared both as US public domain. Added at the coordinator's standing relay (2026-10-02/03: choose public-domain storytellers batches; Adam may veto).
